name: How do I choose the right general contractor for a home renovation?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right general contractor for a home renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Look for licensed, insured, and bonded contractors with verified workers' compensation coverage and documented local renovation experience. Inquire about how they manage projects, coordinate specialty trades like drywall or stucco artisans, and handle unexpected issues behind walls. A reliable remodeling contractor provides clear written estimates, transparent milestone agreements, and open communication channels. Inquire about experience with similar home styles in your immediate area to ensure familiarity with local construction methods.
acceptedAnswer.description: Verify active insurance, bonding, and workers' compensation, review portfolio work, check trade coordination processes, and request clear, detailed project estimates.
